message.reasoning: We need to answer: does response-time metric count weekend and holiday time? According to policy excerpt: By default, response-time metric counts every hour a ticket sits unanswered, including nights, weekends and holidays — wall-clock measurement. So answer: yes, it includes weekends and holidays. Also mention business-hours mode can exclude. Provide short answer.
